historical_style.look: historical cinematic illustration; realistic atmosphere without portrait-like photorealism
historical_style.architecture: period-plausible mud-brick, stone, palms, textiles, parchment, clay and wood
historical_style.women: fully covered; shown from behind, fully veiled, distant or otherwise without visible facial features

generation_rule: When a new Frauen library group or area is added and no bespoke visual exists, generate and commit a matching historical visual before release. Do not silently reuse an unrelated motif.
responsive_rule: Preserve left-aligned readable text and a clearly visible right-side image on phone, tablet and desktop.
